name: Royal National Lifeboat Institution (RNLI)
summary: Runs lifeboats, beach lifeguards and water-safety campaigns around the coasts of the UK and Ireland, crewed mostly by volunteers.

spending.source: https://rnli.org/-/media/rnli/downloads/about_us/how_the_rnli_is_run/annual_reports/annual_report_and_accounts_2025.pdf (RNLI Annual Report and Accounts 2025, statement of financial activities p.41: charitable activities £205.8M of total expenditure £249.5M, year to 31 December 2025; excludes raising funds £43.7M. Pounds converted at $1.3175 a pound, the site's 2025 yearly average (facts/fx.json usd_per_gbp_2025, IRS).)

lines.source: https://rnli.org/-/media/rnli/downloads/about_us/how_the_rnli_is_run/annual_reports/annual_report_and_accounts_2025.pdf (statement of financial activities p.41: lifeboat rescue £170.6M (lifeboat service £55.1M, lifeboats, property and equipment £115.5M) + lifeguard rescue £25.4M + water safety, education and awareness £6.7M = £202.7M.
